title: BIMO GTI 40000 Puffs - Strawberry Watermelon Ice
description:
The New Era of High-Endurance Vaping: BIMO GTI 40000 Puffs
Redefine your expectations of longevity with the BIMO GTI 40000 Puffs, now available at Vape Shop Online Australia. Engineered for the discerning Australian user who values consistency over constant replacements, this device represents the pinnacle of high-capacity hardware. Sourced directly from the original manufacturer, the BIMO GTI 40000 Puffs is not merely a disposable vape; it is a high-performance tool designed to endure. With its substantial build and premium hand-feel, it provides a seamless transition from occasional use to a dedicated daily companion.

Advanced Dual-Cell Technology & Airflow Precision
The BIMO GTI 40000 Puffs sets itself apart through its internal architecture. Featuring a unique dual-cell 650 mAh battery setup, the device ensures a steady voltage output that prevents the drop-off often experienced with standard disposable vapes. This power is paired with a 0.55 ohm dual mesh coil, which maximizes the surface area for a more efficient and uniform heating process.
The inclusion of a Smart Screen Display provides immediate feedback on your remaining capacity and battery levels, removing the guesswork from your routine. Furthermore, the Customisable Airflow Control allows you to toggle between a restricted draw or a more open, airy experience, ensuring the BIMO GTI 40000 Puffs adapts to your specific preferences.
Why the BIMO GTI Leads the Market
Compared to standard industry disposables, the BIMO GTI 40000 Puffs offers superior value and performance:
✅ Extended Lifespan: Outlasts up to 10 standard 4000-puff devices, reducing waste and cost.
✅ Optimised Efficiency: Dual mesh coils provide a more consistent output throughout the 30ml capacity.
✅ Modern Hardware: Type-C fast charging means less downtime and more reliability.
Spotlight: The Strawberry Watermelon Ice Option
Among the diverse range of selections, the Strawberry Watermelon Ice option stands out as a flagship choice. This specific option delivers a balanced, refreshing profile that combines the sweetness of garden-fresh berries with the crisp notes of chilled watermelon. The cooling sensation on the exhale ensures a clean finish, making Strawberry Watermelon Ice a reliable all-day choice for those seeking a crisp and invigorating experience.
Pro-Tip: Maximizing Your BIMO GTI Device
To ensure the best performance from your BIMO GTI 40000 Puffs, we recommend using a standard 5V/1A charging wall adapter. While the Type-C port is capable of rapid charging, avoiding high-wattage "super chargers" will help preserve the integrity of the dual-cell battery over the course of its 40,000-puff lifespan.
